$comment: Single source of truth for the estimated parts of the profile. Edit a pct here and the workflow redraws the bars — never edit badges by hand. Colors are derived (>=70 green, 30-69 yellow, <30 grey). Versions and counts are fetched live by scripts/update-profile.mjs.

products.name: Atlas Commerce (web core)
products.reading: `{{version}}` pre-1.0 blockers closed: DGI routes mounted, dunning fixed, a blank database now provisions itself, and CI guards it. DGI clearance still runs on the stub adapter until the official platform opens

products.name: Atlas Commerce Android
products.reading: `{{version}}` — queue replay, retry policy and receipt guards now covered by contract tests in CI; 404/429 handling, account scoping and totals verified

products.name: Atlas Commerce Desktop
products.reading: On hold at `{{version}}` — paused until the login issue is fixed

products.name: Atlas Shop
products.reading: Not started — the next major build

products.name: Support portal
products.reading: **Not the in-app `/support` page.** A separate help platform: knowledge base, ticket submission and history, status page — reading the same customer records as Atlas Commerce. Only the `SUPPORT-SYNC` hooks and the in-app contact page exist so far

products.name: One connected platform
products.reading: Commerce, Android and the offline contract are live; Shop and the Support portal are the missing halves of the platform

products.name: Atlas Bot + Discord
products.reading: Coming soon — Discord bot and community server

Cart, orders, payment options, stock reservation written back to the ERP

Full module parity and signed auto-updates for all three platforms
Single sign-on across products, one alert inbox, one customer view

Documentation, polish, migrations, v1.x across every client — one platform
